title: Sprint 3 - registry inversion and taxonomy cut
description: SPRINT BRIEF. Invert the directive system so the registry is a flat lookup from gap code to instruction text plus next command, and delete the parallel matching engine. Today: AGENT_DIRECTIVE_REGISTRY entries carry appliesTo predicates over commandPaths, subjectTypes, workStatuses and gates (packages/core/src/agent-directive-registry.ts lines 45-160), a 1369-line compiler resolves matches and conflicts (agent-directive-compiler.ts), a 618-line snapshot assembler feeds it, and a 382-line health module checks the two rule systems stay coherent (agent-directive-health.ts) - the existence of that health checker is the smell this sprint removes. After sprint 2, enforcement emits typed gaps; the bundle builder becomes map gaps to registry entries and fill data slots from the gap payload. Also collapse the severity, kind, lifecycle and lane taxonomy to blocking, required and advisory, and replace the stringly-typed dataRequirements mini-schema with typed payload interfaces. Preserve the safety boundary exactly: instruction text only from the checked-in registry, untrusted content only in quoted data slots. Done when the compiler is a thin projection, conflicts machinery is gone or trivially small, and all directive-bundle consumers (CLI formatting, ui-model lanes, console, MCP) render the new shape.
